name: Honda CA77 Dream 305
engine: 305 cc air-cooled SOHC parallel twin, single carb, points ignition, enclosed chain
intro: The pressed-steel Dream. One carb, a fully enclosed chain and a lot of sheet metal to restore.

add.title: Check the frame and chain case for rust
add.instructions: Look over the pressed-steel frame and the chain enclosure for rust-through, especially at the seams and underneath.
add.reason: The Dream uses a pressed-steel frame and enclosed chain case, which trap water.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
